Reading: only Qwen3-8B and Gemma-2-9B clear chance; shuffling the temporal order costs ≤0.04, and the question-only condition retains a large share of the accuracy → on this slice the score is driven mostly by language prior, not by reading the series.

## Measurement-validity note (handcrafted-feature control on the relation tasks)

R1 stronger trend 0.78 · R6 anomaly vs clean 0.80 (learnable) · R5 same period 0.57 (weak) · **R3 higher volatility 0.47** and **R4 same family 0.50** (not linearly decodable even from engineered features). R3 is unidentifiable after context-only standardisation (σ is divided out); R4/R7 are equality-type relations that a linear head on concatenated features cannot express.
